versions.changelog:
Clash Controller Skill 1.0.0 released with full lifecycle management for Clash/mihomo proxy environments.

- Supports seamless installation, startup, shutdown, and upgrade of Clash/mihomo proxies.
- Provides easy subscription management (add, update, delete, and switch proxies).
- Enables web UI management and quick system proxy toggle commands.
- Adds Tun mode for comprehensive network traffic proxying, including container support.
- All functions are accessible with simple command-line instructions and environment initialization.
- Contains clear usage guidelines and important operational notes for users.
